candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: The problem states to derive the dimensionless relationship governing the normalized equivalent sand-grain roughness ks/Ra using the given input parameters. The output ks/Ra is dimensionless as it is a ratio of two lengths (ks and Ra). The input parameters include length scales (Ra, kt, k_rms) and dimensionless statistical measures (Sk, Ku, ES, Po). The dimensionless output ks/Ra is consistent with the input parameters and physical reasoning.

variables.physical_definition: the first-order absolute moment of height fluctuations, a length scale representing average roughness height
the peak-to-valley height, a length scale representing the vertical distance between highest and lowest roughness points
the root-mean-square height, a length scale representing the standard deviation of roughness height fluctuations
the skewness of roughness height fluctuations, a dimensionless statistical measure of asymmetry
the kurtosis of roughness height fluctuations, a dimensionless statistical measure of peakedness
the effective streamwise slope of the roughness, a dimensionless measure of slope
the surface porosity, a dimensionless measure of void fraction on the surface
